indicators.description: Share of total enrolment (all levels) that is female.

indicators.name: ASC-GEN Teachers
indicators.description: Teachers across all forms: the D.2 staff count (Pre-primary/Primary, JSS, SSS, Technical) plus the Private form's per-qualification teacher counts. One whole-school total.

indicators.name: ASC-GEN Teachers, male
indicators.description: Male teachers, all forms.

indicators.name: ASC-GEN Teachers, female
indicators.description: Female teachers, all forms.

indicators.name: ASC-GEN Pupil-teacher ratio (ratio)
indicators.description: Pupils per teacher (whole school): total enrolment all levels / teachers.

indicators.name: ASC-GEN Non-teaching staff
indicators.description: Non-teaching staff (D.1). Collected by the Pre-primary/Primary, JSS, SSS and Technical forms (not Private or ANFE).

indicators.name: ASC-GEN Pupil-non-teaching staff ratio (ratio)
indicators.description: Pupils per non-teaching staff member (whole school).

indicators.name: ASC-GEN Boarding learners
indicators.description: Boarders, all forms: standard B.11 boarding (Pre-primary/Primary, JSS, SSS, Technical) plus the Private B.14 boarding item. NOTE: Private boarding DE NSuzmYEVsjY has aggregationType NONE and needs SUM to aggregate.

indicators.name: ASC-GEN Boarding learners (%)
indicators.description: Boarders as a share of total enrolment (all levels).

indicators.name: ASC-GEN Usable classrooms (F.2)
indicators.description: Usable classrooms (F.2). Present on all six forms; the consistent cross-form classroom measure (the plain E.1 count is absent from Private/ANFE).

indicators.description: Usable toilets (F.2), all forms (useable option of both facility combos).

indicators.name: ASC-GEN Pupil-usable toilet ratio (ratio)
